exposure: disease flares during pregnancy (including lupus nephritis flare)
outcome: fetal loss (miscarriage and intra-uterine fetal death)
cohort: 123 Egyptian women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) experiencing 201 singleton pregnancies.
finding: Unplanned pregnancy, disease flares during pregnancy, and secondary antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) were identified as significant predictors for adverse maternal and/or fetal outcomes.
